description: Verified corrections for mushaf_lines.first_word_id/last_word_id, derived from tool/mushaf_line_audit_report.json (which cross-checked the raw QUL mushaf-layout resource qpc-v2-15-lines.db.zip against api.quran.com/v4 mushaf=1, the same KFGQPC V2 15-line family) and filtered to pages where the correction is a pure intra-page reslicing: identical line_number set, identical total word span, no gaps/overlaps. Applied by tool/ingest_quran_data.dart._buildMushafLines. Pages with a deeper structural difference (a different line_number set or a shifted page word-span, likely a print-edition variance rather than a simple line-break bug) are intentionally excluded here - see excludedPages - and left on the raw resource's original data pending separate manual verification.
